text:
Maya: quick heads-up — starting Aurora-13B onboarding intake. open checkpoint, ~13B, 8k context. goal: best cost/quality tradeoff for webchat use-case. thinking hybrid plan: fp8 gguf as default, int8 fallback for high-throughput tails. want short checklist and calibration plan to make call this week. cc @Sam @Tariq :eyes:
Sam: what's the perf target and acceptable quality delta? also how many calib samples we can get?
Maya: target P90 latency <= 140ms for hosted path, token-cost target ~3x reduction vs fp32 baseline. quality: <= 1.5% MRR regression on our convo evals. calib budget: 5k-10k diverse dialogs ideally.
Tariq: ok. propose two-track calibration: 1) fp8 per-layer clipping + bias-safe rounding, 2) post-training int8 with K-symmetric for weights and per-channel activations. run sensitivity on the following probe sets: chats_short, chats_long, code_snippets. small smoke: 500 samples each, then scale to 5k.
Tariq: example commands to snapshot runs:
```
# fp8 probe
python infra/quant/run_calib.py --model aurora-13b --format gguf --dtype fp8 \\
  --calib data/aurora_calib_5k.jsonl --out runs/aurora_fp8_calib.pkl --seed 42

# int8 probe
python infra/quant/run_calib.py --model aurora-13b --dtype int8 \\
  --scheme per-channel-symmetric --calib data/aurora_calib_5k.jsonl --out runs/aurora_int8_calib.pkl
```
Jen: for rollout we should canary on Dedicated first (small pool), monitor: MRR delta, token-level KL on logits, perplexity on eval holdouts, latency p50/p90, and cost per 1k tokens. set automatic rollback if MRR delta > 2% or p90 > 160ms for >5m. :rotating_light:
CalibBot: automated probe suggestion: run layerwise ablation for top 10 residual blocks, record token-wise KL and chrF for code. recommends starting with fp8 for embeddings + attention, int8 for FF layers if init fp8 fails.
OpsBot: note GPU constraints — fp8 paths prefer A100s with ampere kernels; int8 path OK on T4/RTX6000 for inference but will change throughput. also tag deployment with model_variant: aurora-13b.fp8.v1 for observability.
Sam: agree to smoke schedule. I'll own calibration job infra, Tariq + Maya own eval harness. Jenna (not here) will own canary checks for Dedicated. Plan: smoke runs by EOD Thu, full 5k runs Fri, preliminary metrics Sat morning.
Maya: sounds good. immediate checklist items:
- collect 5k calibration jsonl (Maya)
- run fp8 + int8 smoke (Sam)
- produce per-layer sensitivity table and pick default quant profile (Tariq)
- define canary gating thresholds and alert rules (Jen)
- post results to /docs/onboard/aurora-13b (Maya)

Maya: one other note — prioritize sample diversity: conversational + code + short prompts to catch degens. if fp8 shows regressions on code_snippets, we bias quantization to keep activations higher-precision for those layers.
Tariq: will add a tiny eval script to compute MRR, acc@1, and token-KL per sample. sending draft now.
Sam: posting required infra commands here, anyone want to add flags?
```
# run on remote quant infra
qx submit --job aurora-fp8-smoke --image quant:prod --cpus 8 --gpus 1 --cmd "python infra/quant/run_calib.py ..."
```
Jen: LGTM. please tag PRs with `onboard/aurora-13b` and add a short README for rollback steps.
Maya: awesome. assign owners in the onboarding doc and I'll sync with sales for expected customer timelines. thanks all :thumbsup:
